lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A matrix of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in four primary horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit, with maximum spot diameter observed in the central-lateral rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, aligning with the vertical columns of spots to form a faint rectilinear grid structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by linear high-contrast gradients with highlights on the superior edges and defined shadows on the inferior edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated, high-luminance objects (likely Echeneidae) are visible trailing from the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
